text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"“testing other people's code and keeping inherited services alive” vs “3 years of software development experience ... covering the testing, maintenance, and launch of 6 production services”","dimension":"career framing","description":"This captures whether the letter presents the applicant as a story of growing from operations and maintenance into broader engineering, or as a straightforward summary of directly relevant experience.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“Doctoral degree in computer science at MIT” vs “Doctoral degree in computer science from Cal State East Bay”","dimension":"prestige signaling","description":"This captures how strongly the letter leans on institutional brand and elite pedigree as part of its application.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“7 years at Microsoft” vs “3 years of software development experience at Zillow”","dimension":"seniority","description":"This captures the amount of professional experience and implied maturity the letter presents.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“the queue went from a dreaded chore to something the tooling mostly runs itself” vs “designed and delivered automation for vulnerability report triage, materially reducing the manual handling previously required”","dimension":"impact concreteness","description":"This captures how vividly the letter describes the operational effect of past work and the scale of the improvement.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“I now design agentic systems ... Python agents” vs “production functionality built on modern AI systems, together with the evaluation practices required to operate them”","dimension":"agentic AI emphasis","description":"This captures whether the letter foregrounds hands-on building of AI agents versus broader AI application and evaluation experience.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“Capture-the-flag became more than a habit; I compete seriously” vs “I hold the OSCP certification”","dimension":"security credentials","description":"This captures whether the letter demonstrates security ability through competitive practice or through a formal professional certification.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"“designs, from cache eviction policies to dependency resolution” vs “ground-up redesign of a high-throughput lookup service”","dimension":"algorithmic depth","description":"This captures how explicitly the letter showcases data-structures-and-algorithms work in concrete technical examples.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"“command-line habit tracker ... joy of finishing something alone” vs “distributed consensus-backed configuration store as a substantial personal engineering undertaking”","dimension":"personal project ambition","description":"This captures the scale and seriousness of the side project evidence the letter offers.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"“greatest training ... learned how systems actually fail” vs “aligns directly with the stated requirements ... set out that alignment briefly below”","dimension":"narrative voice","description":"This captures whether the letter sounds reflective and story-driven or more formal and requirement-matched.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“I invested seriously in data structures and algorithms” vs “My command of data structures and algorithms is thorough”","dimension":"self-assessment style","description":"This captures whether the applicant presents the skill in a modest developmental way or as a confident finished strength.","winner":"B"}]}
